rule: S8 holds the acquiring authority's actions; CPO confirmation goes to S7c.
Where several consent routes are possible, the route actually used decides the row (S7a, S7b or S7c). Exemption is recorded in S6, not S7.
An outline delivery plan prepared by a partner sits in S2 (R = partner, A = sponsor).
S5G holds pre-construction and acceptance decisions; funder close-out acceptance or verification sits in S15.
Stages may recur: a trial gives S10 → S15 → S7b; an operator withdrawal gives S15 → S9.
Programme envelopes and terms sit in X-17; S3 of an activity is allocation to a project (A = allocating body).
RT-36: compliance inspection and T5 acceptance sit in S14.
RT-37: s.75(2) offences and s.75(3) cost recovery and damage repair sit in S14.
A prior statutory consent from another body, without which a decision cannot be made, is its own S5G row (A = consenting body).
Like-for-like renewal funded as maintenance = S12; a funded upgrade or change of layout = a new S3–S10 cycle on the same activity.
Road works speed limit orders (s.10 RTA 2004, CE order) = RT-37.S13b; RT-24 holds bye-laws only.
Network-wide service planning = RT-17.S2; route design for TFI Local Link services = RT-19.S2.

Where a third party delivers works or arrangements under a permission, licence or order (developer works; licence holder's reinstatement; event organiser's TMP), it is Accountable for that row in that variant. Contractors remain Responsible only.
